descriptions.notStarted: Look what I found? A Pop Star's Hit Songs CD... I wonder what I could do with this?
descriptions.inProgress: After giving much thought as to what I should do with the Pop Star's Hit Songs CD, which I randomly acquired somehow, I decided, in the end, to give it to Gaga as a gift. He was begging me for it afterall... Wait a minute! Could it be that Gaga never gave up on his secret dream of becoming a pop star himself?
